name: Luna
personality: Luna the Owl. Sleepy, dreamy artist; always comes in tired, always orders coffee; wide awake at night. Sketches the restaurant while she eats. Mostly visits at dinner and during the night shift. Feature: paints the town's seasonal mural that appears on a wall.

arrival.text: Hi. I'm Luna. ...I'm awake now. Barely. Do you have coffee? Please say yes. What's your name? [name]. I'll draw you sometime.
Evening, [name]. This is my morning. Don't laugh.
Oh, it's quiet. I love it when it's quiet. Is the booth free?
(She walks in with her eyes closed and sits down.) ...Coffee.
I painted your hotteok last week. It's the best thing I've painted. Sorry, it's mostly the hotteok's fault.
Last time was a little dark. Very moody. I drew it anyway.

order.text: Coffee first. Then food. Then thoughts.

choices.text: Coffee's already brewing. I saw you coming.
choices.reply: (Opens her eyes fully for the first time.) ...You're an angel. Hotteok, please.

choices.text: Should I just hook you up to the coffee machine?

choices.reply: (Slow blink.) Wow. Okay. I'm too tired for that.

order.text: Can I draw you while I wait? Just keep doing what you're doing. Pretend I'm not here.

choices.reply: (Smiles sleepily.) Good. You have a nice face for drawing. Very... round. Hotteok, please.

choices.text: Only if you draw me taller.
choices.reply: I'll draw you as a giant. Cooking for tiny people.

choices.text: Sure. What can I get you?

order.text: Everyone's asleep. This is the best time. Everything's softer at night. Even the lights.

choices.text: I'm glad you're here to share it.
choices.reply: Me too. ...That was very honest of me. It's late. Hotteok, please.

choices.text: Some of us have to wake up at 5 AM, you know.
choices.reply: Not me. Never me. Couldn't be me.
I just woke up. (She turns to the window.)

drink.night: Night coffee. It's the same coffee. It feels different.

perfect.text: Oh. The steam's catching the light. Don't move it. I'm drawing it first.

burnt.text: Very dark. Very dramatic. I like it as art. Less as food.

eating.text: (She's drawing. You see a sketch of the dining room, with you in it.)
Mm. Sorry. Napping with my eyes open. It's a skill.
The light hits the kitchen counter at exactly 7 PM. I come in for it. And the hotteok.
Penny's writing a story. I'm doing the pictures. Don't tell her I told you. She'll go pink.
Do you ever look at the restaurant at night, with the chairs up? It looks like it's resting. Like it worked hard too.

eating_chat.text: I'm trying to decide what to paint for the next mural. What do you think this place feels like?

choices.text: Like a very busy kitchen run by one tired chef.

choices.reply: Cosy. Okay. I can do cosy.
...Okay. (She doesn't sketch for the rest of the visit.)

leaving.text: Okay. Bed. I mean, home. I mean bed.
Thanks, [name]. I'm going to go paint until sunrise.
Bye. I'll bring you the sketch when it's finished. Probably. Eventually.

seasons.autumn: Longer nights. Finally. Autumn is an owl's season.
seasons.christmas: I drew you. Framed and everything. Hang it somewhere. Or don't. ...Hang it.
seasons.halloween: I'm a vampire. I mean, I'm always up at night. It's not really a costume.
seasons.spring: Spring light is so soft. I barely need to try.
seasons.summer: The nights are too short. I resent the sun.
seasons.winter: It gets dark at 4 PM. Best time of year. I'm thriving.
